judgment: It is good to hold firm.
image: So the noble one joins friends
lines: He weighs his gladness, not yet settled:
if he keeps clear of sickness, there is joy.
He trusts in what peels away,
and there is danger in it.

notes.name_en: 兌 is open gladness (its trigram image is the marsh); 'Gladness', not Wilhelm's 'The Joyous, Lake'.
notes.L4: 商 weighing deliberating; 介疾 keeping a firm border against sickness/court flatterers — 'keep clear'.
